title: Journal pnl is gross local compute (-786.10) vs venue closed_pnl (-888.30) on trade 6817: which is stored as pnl, should every close take venue closed_pnl
note: Links to COST-BROKER-SOURCED. Trade 6817 (bybit_1 XRPUSDT long, 74160 qty): journal pnl -786.096 (pnl_source local_compute = (1.2476-1.2582)*74160, no fees) vs Bybit closed_pnl -888.3026 (venue figure, includes fees; journal fee_taker_usd estimate 102.64 + 786.10 = 888.74 vs 888.30). Questions: (1) is journal pnl meant to be gross with fees held separately in fee_*_usd, or net; (2) should every close take venue closed_pnl where the venue serves a trustworthy one (demo closed-pnl is deliberately untrusted, BL-20260608-DEMOPNL, so for bybit_1 the gap is by design); (3) which figure do graders and promotion records read. Measure over closed bybit rows: sum(pnl) vs sum(venue closed_pnl) per account before deciding.
